kind: Proposed launch-controller calibration, not a change to saved v7 grading
throttle_rule: On each 1/120 s pilot exchange use low_speed_throttle when hypot(vx,vz)<14, otherwise 1. This is speed feedback, not a latched switch or ramp.
initial_state: Each attempt resets to the original from-rest runway initial state; timing_bias=.3.
other_controls: Original pitch controller and bank manoeuvre unchanged.
task_result: Proposed pass if any full power-limited-flight attempt passes; retain all attempted failures. No change implemented to published grader.
